notes: Overview: Corroborate builds a compliance-first e-discovery product used by large law firms and corporate legal teams. They ingest email, contracts, litigation bundles (~200M docs peak for enterprise customers).

Primary ask: RAG-enabled search with high-quality embeddings + reranking pipeline to surface short, defensible answers and original doc provenance. Focused on: indexing scale, cost-per-query, end-to-end latency and auditability.

Technical constraints: must run in customer VPC or on-prem private deployment. No persisted PII in Redwood-hosted logs. KMS-managed keys, HSM available for on-prem. Retention: 7+ years for activity logs; audit logs must be immutable for 90 days minimum.

Performance targets: 95th percentile RL retrieval + rerank < 250ms for primary workflows (goal: 150ms). Throughput target for enterprise plan: 300 qps sustained for batch discovery runs. Cost target: ~$0.03-$0.08 per query depending on depth of rerank (customer asked: "Can we hit $0.05/query at 95ms?").

Indexing scale notes: initial POC with 10M doc subset. Production projection 50–250M vectors. Candidate vector store techs: FAISS IVF/PQ, Milvus, Annoy considered. They want guidance on sharding & incremental indexing and prefix/KV cache strategies.

Reranking requirements: must preserve exact doc ids and ground-truth snippets for defensibility. Prefer a two-stage pipeline: sparse BM25 -> dense embeddings -> lightweight cross-encoder for top-50 rerank. Model preferences: open LLMs fine-tuned for legal tone; on-prem model hosting allowed.

Security/compliance: SSO via SAML + SCIM, fine-grained audit trails per user and per-token, WORM audit storage optional. Need SOC2 Type II evidence and ISO attestation for vendor evaluation. Data residency: US and EU partitions required for certain customers.

POC plan: 1) baseline embeddings (all-MiniLM) + FAISS on a 10M corpus, measure recall/latency/cost 2) swap to 1536-d embeddings + PQ quantization for prod cost test 3) integrate cross-encoder rerank and measure p95 latency 4) validate VPC private control plane and KMS rotation flow.
